analyst.summary: Capri Global is a fast-growing, diversified NBFC with lending books in MSME, affordable housing and gold loans, and its numbers are moving in the right direction: profits rising each quarter, asset quality improving, and margins strong. We rate it a Hold: the growth story is credible, but a meaningful share of recent growth comes from a newer, smaller gold-loan business scaling up, so we would want to see this sustain over more quarters before treating the pace as fully steady-state.
